text:
lucy: FYI deploy-bot flagged a finalize checksum mismatch for billing-worker:pr-7221 when publishing to staging. push aborted.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: finalize_digest_mismatch. details:
  tag=staging-pr-7221
  computed=sha256:deadbeef1234...
  server_final=sha256:deadc0de5678...
  layers_uploaded=6/6
  action=abort

omar: interesting, layers uploaded completed but finalized digest differs. could be proxy fragmentation or a mirror rewrite during finalize. any mirror jobs for this tag?

infra-bot: mirror job to gcr-eu kicked off concurrently. mirror-proxy-11 shows intermittent 502/504 around 2025-10-28T20:10:45Z. S3 multipart logs show chunk retries from builder-12. opening INF-2077 to track.

ci-bot: pipeline shows cosign sign step succeeded for artifact ci-build-7221 and recorded attestation at sha256:deadbeef1234..., but publish finalization recorded a different digest. sign happened before mirror replication started.

lucy: plan proposal: (1) pin staging slot to last-known-good digest to avoid accidental rollout; (2) republish the existing CI artifact (no rebuild) to a new explicit tag from CI cache; (3) sign/attach attestation AFTER republish and verify across mirrors; (4) hold promote until canary verifies.

deploy-bot: previous_staging_digest for billing-worker -> sha256:aa11aa22... (2025-10-27T05:02:01Z)

omar: commands I recommend (reuse ci-artifact id ci-7221):
```
# republish without rebuild
publishbot republish --artifact ci-7221 --target-tag staging-repub-7221 --force --preserve-manifest
# sign and attach provenance after republish finalizes
cosign sign --kms kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-prod billing-worker:staging-repub-7221
provenance attach --artifact billing-worker:staging-repub-7221 --file attestation.json
# verify on mirrors
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-prod billing-worker@sha256:aa11aa22...
```

release-manager: approve hold. remove billing-worker from the EU change window and add to release notes: "billing-worker staging publish held due to finalize checksum mismatch; republish + reattest in progress."

infra-bot: INF-2077: investigating mirror-proxy-11 5xx burst and adding auto-rotate policy if error rate > 3/min. also enabling finalize-stage checksum assertion in publishbot for republish runs.

ci-bot: kicking republish now: ci-7221 -> staging-repub-7221. watch: https://publishbot.internal/redwood/ops/7221

lucy: note for deploybot: if cosign attestation references a digest != finalized manifest, publishbot should reject it and fail fast. we saw a race where sign used a pre-finalized tag. add to publishbot backlog.

publish-bot: republish completed. staging-repub-7221 -> sha256:aa11aa22...

ci-bot: cosign sign completed and attestation attached. cosign verify -> OK for billing-worker@sha256:aa11aa22...

deploy-bot: staging tag staging-repub-7221 pinned to sha256:aa11aa22...; attestation present on primary registry. starting mirror verification across GCR.

omar: verifying attestation visible on gcr mirrors and that digest matches. also checking pull metrics for the canary.

infra-bot: mirror verification: gcr-eu reflects sha256:aa11aa22... and attestation metadata present. no further 5xx bursts recorded after auto-rotate trigger.

lucy: starting a short staging canary. will watch errors/pull failures for 20m.

release-manager: hold remains for production promote. will update release notes: "billing-worker republish successful; holding production promote until canary green and INF-2077 postmortem."

lucy: canary green after 22m. metrics stable, no pull errors. ready for manual promote outside EU change window tomorrow.

omar: retro items: add finalize retry/backoff in publishbot, enforce attestation-digest guard, and add a preflight that mirrors must not mutate manifests/annotations.

release-manager: thanks team 44d. leaving hold and changelog updated. INF-2077 will track longer-term infra fixes and the publishbot PR."
